recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Revisit only if the Security WG separately decides that the Security Principles page should duplicate the module-level User Identity and Access Context guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-12939 was a Published Security WG change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification for DSTU2, asking that the Security Role vocabulary and PurposeOfUse vocabulary be discussed more prominently on the Security and Privacy module/security page. The accepted wording asked for guidance that users have functional and/or structural roles declared when relevant, that roles use standard codes, that purpose of use be asserted for requested resource actions using standard codes, and that OAuth authorization services may manage and convey role and purpose-of-use information in JWT security tokens.
initial_application: Commit 84f8086d21facb3551bfb28481156250510ae48b explicitly listed GF#12939 in a Security and Privacy Module update and added the requested User Identity and Access Context guidance to source/secpriv-module.html.
additional_context: Current source/secpriv-module.html still contains the accepted role, purpose-of-use, and OAuth/JWT guidance. Later Security WG terminology decisions, especially FHIR-32520, changed the former broad security-role-type value set into the current example structural-role value set, which explains the current link text. source/security.html already mentions user role and purpose of use as authorization decision inputs, so duplicating the module wording there would be redundant rather than a required correction.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. The current build-scope source already satisfies the issue when later terminology refinements are considered.

related_jiras.note: Explains why the old security role value set became an example structural-role value set, supporting the current Example Security Role Vocabulary link.
Later AuditEvent role/type cleanup shows continued Security WG refinement of role terminology but does not require a FHIR-12939 source change.
